verses.restored: Bless YHWH, O my soul. O YHWH my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

familiar.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

modern.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul! O LORD my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty.

original.text: בָּרֲכִ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶת יְה֫וָ֥ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי גָּדַ֣לְתָּ מְּאֹ֑ד ה֭וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר לָבָֽשְׁתָּ

verses.restored: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

familiar.text: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

modern.text: He wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent,

original.text: עֹֽטֶה א֭וֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָ֑ה נוֹטֶ֥ה שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם כַּיְרִיעָֽה

verses.restored: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

familiar.text: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

modern.text: laying the beams of His chambers in the waters above, making the clouds His chariot, walking on the wings of the wind.

original.text: הַ֥מְקָרֶֽה בַמַּ֗יִם עֲֽלִיּ֫וֹתָ֥יו הַשָּׂם עָבִ֥ים רְכוּב֑וֹ הַֽ֝מְהַלֵּ֗ךְ עַל כַּנְפֵי רֽוּחַ

verses.restored: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

familiar.text: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

modern.text: He makes the winds His messengers, flames of fire His servants.

original.text: עֹשֶׂ֣ה מַלְאָכָ֣יו רוּח֑וֹת מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו אֵ֣שׁ לֹהֵֽט

verses.restored: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.

familiar.text: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.

modern.text: He set the earth on its foundations, never to be moved.

original.text: יָֽסַד אֶ֭רֶץ עַל מְכוֹנֶ֑יהָ בַּל תִּ֝מּ֗וֹט עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד

verses.restored: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

familiar.text: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

modern.text: You covered it with the deep like a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.

original.text: תְּ֭הוֹם כַּלְּב֣וּשׁ כִּסִּית֑וֹ עַל הָ֝רִ֗ים יַֽעַמְדוּ מָֽיִם

verses.restored: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

familiar.text: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

modern.text: At Your rebuke the waters fled; at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away—

original.text: מִן גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְנוּס֑וּן מִן ק֥וֹל רַֽ֝עַמְךָ֗ יֵחָפֵזֽוּן

verses.restored: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys to the place which thou hast founded for them.

familiar.text: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.

modern.text: the mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place You assigned for them—

original.text: יַעֲל֣וּ הָ֭רִים יֵרְד֣וּ בְקָע֑וֹת אֶל מְ֝ק֗וֹם זֶ֤ה יָסַ֬דְתָּ לָהֶֽם

verses.restored: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

familiar.text: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

modern.text: You set a boundary they cannot cross, that they may never again cover the earth.

original.text: גְּֽבוּל שַׂ֭מְתָּ בַּל יַֽעֲבֹר֑וּן בַּל יְ֝שׁוּב֗וּן לְכַסּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

familiar.text: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

modern.text: He sends forth springs in the valleys; they flow between the mountains.

original.text: הַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ מַ֭עְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִ֑ים בֵּ֥ין הָ֝רִ֗ים יְהַלֵּכֽוּן

verses.restored: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

familiar.text: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

modern.text: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.

original.text: יַ֭שְׁקוּ כָּל חַיְת֣וֹ שָׂדָ֑י יִשְׁבְּר֖וּ פְרָאִ֣ים צְמָאָֽם

verses.restored: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.

familiar.text: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.

modern.text: The birds of the air nest beside the springs; they sing among the branches.

original.text: עֲ֭לֵיהֶם עוֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׁכּ֑וֹן מִבֵּ֥ין עֳ֝פָאיִ֗ם יִתְּנוּ קֽוֹל

verses.restored: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

familiar.text: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

modern.text: He waters the mountains from His chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works.

original.text: מַשְׁקֶ֣ה הָ֭רִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָ֑יו מִפְּרִ֥י מַ֝עֲשֶׂ֗יךָ תִּשְׂבַּ֥ע הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

familiar.text: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

modern.text: He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate, bringing forth food from the earth:

original.text: מַצְמִ֤יחַ חָצִ֨יר לַבְּהֵמָ֗ה וְ֭עֵשֶׂב לַעֲבֹדַ֣ת הָאָדָ֑ם לְה֥וֹצִיא לֶ֝֗חֶם מִן הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart.

familiar.text: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart.

modern.text: wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil that makes his face to shine, and bread that sustains his heart.

original.text: וְיַ֤יִן יְשַׂמַּ֬ח לְֽבַב אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְהַצְהִ֣יל פָּנִ֣ים מִשָּׁ֑מֶן וְ֝לֶ֗חֶם לְֽבַב אֱנ֥וֹשׁ יִסְעָֽד

verses.restored: The trees of YHWH are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

familiar.text: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

modern.text: The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,

original.text: יִ֭שְׂבְּעוּ עֲצֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אַֽרְזֵ֥י לְ֝בָנ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָטָֽע

verses.restored: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.

familiar.text: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.

modern.text: where the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.

original.text: אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֭ם צִפֳּרִ֣ים יְקַנֵּ֑נוּ חֲ֝סִידָ֗ה בְּרוֹשִׁ֥ים בֵּיתָֽהּ

verses.restored: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.

familiar.text: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.

modern.text: The high mountains are for the wild goats, the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers.

original.text: הָרִ֣ים הַ֭גְּבֹהִים לַיְּעֵלִ֑ים סְ֝לָעִ֗ים מַחְסֶ֥ה לַֽשְׁפַנִּֽים

verses.restored: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

familiar.text: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

modern.text: He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.

original.text: עָשָׂ֣ה יָ֭רֵחַ לְמוֹעֲדִ֑ים שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ יָדַ֥ע מְבוֹאֽוֹ

verses.restored: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

familiar.text: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

modern.text: You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.

original.text: תָּֽשֶׁת חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וִ֣יהִי לָ֑יְלָה בּֽוֹ תִ֝רְמֹ֗שׂ כָּל חַיְתוֹ יָֽעַר

verses.restored: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

familiar.text: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

modern.text: The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.

original.text: הַ֭כְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִ֣ים לַטָּ֑רֶף וּלְבַקֵּ֖שׁ מֵאֵ֣ל אָכְלָֽם

verses.restored: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

familiar.text: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

modern.text: The sun rises, and they withdraw; they lie down in their dens.

original.text: תִּזְרַ֣ח הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפ֑וּן וְאֶל מְ֝עוֹנֹתָ֗ם יִרְבָּצֽוּן

verses.restored: Man goeth forth to his work and to his labour until the evening.

familiar.text: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

modern.text: Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening.

original.text: יֵצֵ֣א אָדָ֣ם לְפָעֳל֑וֹ וְֽלַעֲבֹ֖דָת֣וֹ עֲדֵי עָֽרֶב

verses.restored: O YHWH, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

familiar.text: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

modern.text: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.

original.text: מָֽה רַבּ֬וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֨יךָ יְֽהוָ֗ה כֻּ֭לָּם בְּחָכְמָ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ מָלְאָ֥ה הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ קִנְיָנֶֽךָ

verses.restored: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

familiar.text: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

modern.text: Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.

original.text: זֶ֤ה הַיָּ֥ם גָּדוֹל֮ וּרְחַ֪ב יָ֫דָ֥יִם שָֽׁם רֶ֭מֶשׂ וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר חַיּ֥וֹת קְ֝טַנּ֗וֹת עִם גְּדֹלֽוֹת

verses.restored: There the ships travel, and Leviathan, whom you formed to play in it.

familiar.text: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.

notes.title: Leviathan at play
notes.body: Leviathan appears here as a creature formed by God to play in the sea, a strikingly non-combat image that should be preserved alongside other biblical Leviathan traditions.

modern.text: There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.

original.text: שָׁ֭ם אֳנִיּ֣וֹת יְהַלֵּכ֑וּן לִ֝וְיָתָ֗ן זֶֽה יָצַ֥רְתָּ לְשַֽׂחֶק בּֽוֹ

verses.restored: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.

familiar.text: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.

modern.text: All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.

original.text: כֻּ֭לָּם אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּר֑וּן לָתֵ֖ת אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ

verses.restored: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

familiar.text: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

modern.text: When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.

original.text: תִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם יִלְקֹט֑וּן תִּפְתַּ֥ח יָֽ֝דְךָ֗ יִשְׂבְּע֥וּן טֽוֹב

verses.restored: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

familiar.text: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

modern.text: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.

original.text: תַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנֶיךָ֮ יִֽבָּהֵ֫ל֥וּן תֹּסֵ֣ף ר֭וּחָם יִגְוָע֑וּן וְֽאֶל עֲפָרָ֥ם יְשׁוּבֽוּן

verses.restored: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

familiar.text: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

modern.text: When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.

original.text: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח ר֭וּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵא֑וּן וּ֝תְחַדֵּ֗שׁ פְּנֵ֣י אֲדָמָֽה

verses.restored: The glory of YHWH shall endure for ever: YHWH shall rejoice in his works.

familiar.text: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.

modern.text: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works.

original.text: יְהִ֤י כְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֣ה לְעוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂמַ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה בְּמַעֲשָֽׂיו

verses.restored: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

familiar.text: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

modern.text: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.

original.text: הַמַּבִּ֣יט לָ֭אָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָ֑ד יִגַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ

verses.restored: I will sing to YHWH as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

familiar.text: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

modern.text: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

original.text: אָשִׁ֣ירָה לַיהוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי

verses.restored: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in YHWH.

familiar.text: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.

modern.text: May my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD.

original.text: יֶעֱרַ֣ב עָלָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י אָ֝נֹכִ֗י אֶשְׂמַ֥ח בַּיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou YHWH, O my soul. Praise ye YHWH.

familiar.text: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.

modern.text: May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah!

original.text: יִתַּ֤מּוּ חַטָּאִ֨ים מִן הָאָ֡רֶץ וּרְשָׁעִ֤ים ע֤וֹד אֵינָ֗ם בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת יְהוָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Human use of creation does not authorize ecological destruction or cruelty; creation has value beyond utility to humans.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, acrostic structure, duplicate/reused psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
